reason: The already-frozen REST /api/v3/klines semantic candidate returned API_EMPTY for the complete December 2024 overlap on all six symbols after the parent-path bug was corrected. This is treated as source-access limitation, not a market-value mismatch. The original V0.1D authority itself used official MEXC Spot bulk Min15 files, so the next source-only recovery method returns to the same official historical bulk family.

official_source_family.official_documentation_statement: MEXC Spot API documentation links Download Historical Market Data and states that kline/trading data are provided for all Spot pairs since 2023-01-01.

pre_outcome_equivalence_gate.pass_requires: For every symbol, the official current bulk candidate must resolve unambiguously and match the exact parent December-2024 file on timestamps and all seven market/value fields. Byte SHA256 equality is additionally recorded but semantic field equality is the mandatory source-equivalence criterion.

unlock_policy.on_gate_pass: May build a separately frozen 2025 reacquisition/replay step using only the same MEXC official bulk source family and the already committed 72-record V0.1D manifest.
unlock_policy.on_gate_fail: Do not use current MEXC bulk as a semantic replacement for the frozen V0.1D source.
